verdict.rationale: Render clearly delivers managed full-stack app deployment. Its docs show git-push deploys, Docker support, managed databases and caches, background workers, load-based autoscaling, and a global CDN for static assets, and community users describe it as an easier-to-set-up Heroku alternative. However, nothing documents serverless or edge functions as such: the closest analogue is Workflows SDK tasks, which are not described as serverless or edge, and the CDN covers static assets only. Missing for 10: an explicit serverless or edge function runtime, evidence of compute running at edge locations, and independent hands-on corroboration of a function-style deployment model.
